summary: SU Group Holdings Ltd filed a 6-K announcing board approval to adjust the exercise price of warrants issued May 13, 2026 from $5.50 to $0.87 per share, effective June 17, 2026, to incentivize exercise and raise capital. The adjustment, approved by warrant holders, aims to align with market conditions and support working capital, marketing, and M&A. No proceeds are guaranteed. This is akin to a warrant repricing to encourage conversion, not a tender or return. Watch for exercise rates and potential dilution; risk-arb is minimal as it is a voluntary capital-raising mechanism.
